name: journeyman-sim
description: Synthetic CNC training environment: multi-camera Three.js rig with scripted scenarios and a render-then-ingest proof pipeline.

scripts.verify:rig: esbuild scripts/verify-cam-rig.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:three --outfile=scripts/verify-cam-rig.bundle.mjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/verify-cam-rig.bundle.mjs && rm scripts/verify-cam-rig.bundle.mjs
scripts.verify:scenarios: esbuild scripts/verify-scenarios.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/verify-scenarios.bundle.mjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/verify-scenarios.bundle.mjs && rm scripts/verify-scenarios.bundle.mjs
scripts.verify:factory: esbuild scripts/verify-factory.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:three --external:esbuild --outfile=scripts/verify-factory.bundle.mjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/verify-factory.bundle.mjs && rm scripts/verify-factory.bundle.mjs
